clue.text: Sue needs to pack a formal rig-out

definitions.meaning: to sue someone is to take legal action against them in court
read literally, to put a lounge suit or similar formal outfit into your luggage

explanation.surface: Someone called Sue has to remember to put a smart outfit in the case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sue' looks like a woman's name but is the verb for taking someone to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Lodging a lawsuit is exactly what suing means; the phrase is the legal idiom for it.

clue.text: An excellent shot? Rubbish!

definitions.meaning: in darts or archery the bullseye, the centre of the target, hit by a top shot

explanation.definitionFit: The bullseye of a target is often shortened to this word, and it is also slang for nonsense.

clue.text: Available for use at church

definitions.meaning: working and in operation, as a machine or vehicle may be

explanation.surface: A notice saying something can be used at church.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus still running is in operation; worshippers present at a service are likewise attending it.

clue.text: Immature ecologist

definitions.meaning: inexperienced or naive, as unripe fruit is
an environmentalist, a supporter of conservation politics

explanation.surface: A young, naive environmental campaigner.
explanation.definitionFit: The colour word means both unripe or inexperienced and environmentally minded.

clue.text: Cry uttered by American- Indian in school

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the abbreviation for school

parts.note: the Cree are a Native American people of Canada

explanation.surface: A shout let out by a Native American pupil at school.
explanation.definitionFit: A screech is a harsh, piercing cry, a synonym for a shrill shout.

clue.text: Steamed up because it's a new arrangement

indicators.note: an arrangement of letters puts them in a different order, so the preceding words are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone is agitated because things have been reorganised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' signals that the letters of IT'S A NEW are to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are idioms for being agitated or flustered.

clue.text: Darling, it's utterly futile

indicators.note: uttered here means spoken, so a word that is said aloud is wanted

parts.note: idle can mean pointless or futile, as in idle threats

explanation.surface: Someone tells a beloved that it is completely hopeless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utterly' looks like 'completely' but signals a word said out loud.
explanation.definitionFit: A darling, a favourite of the public, is a celebrated figure who is adored.

clue.text: Routine regime makes medic sick

parts.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor
sick means ill

explanation.surface: A daily routine so tough it makes the doctor himself ill.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill is a repeated, set exercise routine, as in a fire drill or army drill.

clue.text: Allowed to walk with single friend

parts.note: leg it is slang for to go on foot or run off
I is the Roman numeral one
mate is British for a friend

explanation.surface: Permission to go out walking with an unmarried friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Legitimate means lawful or permitted, a synonym for allowed.

clue.text: Purported to serve out cold ales

indicators.note: serving out spreads the letters around, so the words cold and ales are mixed up

explanation.surface: Something claimed to be a way of serving chilled beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serve out' tells you to rearrange the letters of COLD ALES.
explanation.definitionFit: So-called means supposed or alleged, as purported things are claimed but doubtful.

clue.text: I sell woven material

indicators.note: weaving twists threads together, so the words I sell are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A trader says they sell woven cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'woven' tells you to rearrange the letters of I SELL.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle is a fine, smooth cotton thread and the fabric made from it.

clue.text: Each lad in the circle is applying logic

indicators.note: two pieces are put within the ring

parts.note: a ring is a circle
a son is a boy or lad

explanation.surface: Every boy standing in the circle is thinking things through.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoning is the process of thinking logically, a near-synonym of applying logic.

clue.text: Time to get parents involved in the church

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters of parents are muddled

explanation.surface: It is time for the parents to become active in church life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Time to get parents involved' reads as a call to churchgoing families; the definition is a part of the church building, not the congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: A transept is the cross arm of a cruciform church, so it is found inside the building.

clue.text: Everyone returned to make a distribution

parts.note: all means everyone

indicators.note: something returned goes back, so the little word to is turned round

explanation.surface: Everybody went back to share things out.
explanation.definitionFit: To allot is to share out or distribute portions.

clue.text: Used another bunch of bananas

parts.note: a second one is another one
a hand is the trade term for a cluster of bananas

explanation.surface: Someone has eaten a further bunch of bananas.
explanation.definitionFit: Second-hand goods have already been owned, so they are used.

clue.text: A grave pronouncement

parts.note: seems to mean a solemn announcement, but grave is the burial place: words inscribed on a tombstone

explanation.definitionFit: An epitaph is the inscription on a tomb, a statement literally set on a grave.

clue.text: A bighead worked it out and was pardoned

parts.note: read as big head, the head of big, its first letter B
solved means worked it out

explanation.surface: A conceited person figured it out and was forgiven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bighead' looks like a conceited person but is read as the head of 'big', its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To be absolved is to be formally forgiven or freed from guilt.

clue.text: He displays resolution 60 minutes after midnight

parts.note: will means determination or resolution
one o'clock in the morning is 1am, read as I AM with I the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A man shows determination in the small hours.
explanation.walkthrough: The time after midnight is 1am, with the Roman numeral I for one.
explanation.definitionFit: William is a man's name, so it can stand for 'he'.

clue.text: Irate politician interrupted unruly trainee

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the middle of another
unruly means disorderly, so the letters of trainee are jumbled

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An angry politician cut in on a badly behaved apprentice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Irate politician' tempts you to look for an angry MP as the definition, but 'Irate' alone defines and the politician goes inside the jumbled trainee.
explanation.definitionFit: Being irate is being angry, which this idiom expresses.

clue.text: Manage to write poems in Old English

indicators.note: one piece goes within the abbreviation for Old English

parts.note: to verse is an old verb meaning to write poetry

explanation.surface: Someone manages to compose poetry in Anglo-Saxon.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to supervise or manage.

clue.text: Switched on and talented finally

annotationWithheld.why: Switched on and talented finally (7): ENABLED is ABLE (talented) inside END (finally), but no clue word signals the insertion; the clue as held seems cut short or misread, and a search found no fuller text.

clue.text: Produce new scheme about US conscription

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the draft is the American term for compulsory military service

explanation.surface: Drawing up a fresh plan concerning military call-ups in America.
explanation.definitionFit: To redraft is to write a fresh version of a plan or document.

clue.text: Husband about to carry out his duties

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to serve is to perform one's duties

explanation.surface: A married man is about to get on with his chores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Husband' looks like a noun but is the verb meaning to conserve or save.
explanation.definitionFit: To husband resources is to keep them back carefully, the same as to reserve them.

clue.text: Live with daughter in some comfort

parts.note: living well means living comfortably

explanation.surface: Living with a daughter in reasonable ease.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell somewhere is to live or reside there.

clue.text: Some recent errors in the register

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few recent mistakes have been recorded in the official register.
explanation.definitionFit: To enter details is to record them, as in the register of a book or list.

clue.text: Edward's an idiot needing to be helped

parts.note: an ass is a fool
Edward's is read as Edward is, giving the verb is
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A fool named Edward needs someone to help him.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Edward's' stands for 'is'; the pieces are arranged as ASS, IS, TED.
explanation.definitionFit: Assisted means aided or helped.

clue.text: Ray gains access to mine

definitions.meaning: a ... of light is a beam or ray
a mine ... is the vertical passage into a mine

explanation.surface: A beam of light finds its way into a mine.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a beam of light and the passage sunk into a mine.

clue.text: Old seamen's union showing responsibility

parts.note: the NUS was the National Union of Seamen in Britain

explanation.surface: A veteran sailors' trade union taking charge.
explanation.definitionFit: An onus is a burden or duty, a synonym for responsibility.

clue.text: Drunken trader imbibed beer — in his gallery?

indicators.note: imbibing means drinking in, so one piece is taken inside another
a drunken word staggers about, so the letters of trader are mixed up

parts.note: ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: A tipsy merchant has drunk beer, perhaps in his own gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks a definition by example: an art dealer is just one person who might be found in a gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer in paintings is the person who might be found running a gallery, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Tree in a small enclosure

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A tree growing inside a little fenced pen.
explanation.definitionFit: The aspen is a kind of poplar tree with trembling leaves.

clue.text: Rush out to get a missile

definitions.meaning: a small pointed missile thrown or fired

explanation.surface: Someone dashes outside to fetch a projectile.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sudden quick movement and a small thrown projectile.

clue.text: Commercial ventures necessitate risks

parts.note: an ad is a commercial or advertisement
taken as written

explanation.surface: Business enterprises inevitably involve taking chances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Commercial' looks like an adjective describing ventures but is the noun meaning an advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: Adventures are risky undertakings, so risks is a loose synonym.
